explanation: A special year celebrated every 50th year, when debts were forgiven, slaves set free, and land returned to its original owners.
A period of one year during which the land was to rest and not be cultivated, occurring every seventh year.
To buy back something or someone, such as property or a slave, often by paying a sum of money.
A person who is related to another person, either by blood or through marriage.
A person who was formerly a slave but has now been set free and restored their rights.
An agreement in which one person is granted the use of property or services from another person in exchange for payment.
A contract between two parties where one party grants the other the right to use their property, usually agricultural land, in return for payment.
